desc.en: Thin, wide band across the front of the sacro-iliac joint, a thickening of the anterior capsule.
desc.id: Pita tipis dan lebar yang melintang di depan articulatio sacroiliaca, merupakan penebalan bagian anterior capsula articularis.

attach.en: From the pelvic surface of the lateral part of the sacrum to the adjoining margin of the auricular surface of the ilium.
attach.id: Dari facies pelvica pars lateralis os sacrum ke tepi facies auricularis os ilium di dekatnya.

function.en: Closes the joint in front; it is the weakest of the sacro-iliac ligaments.
function.id: Menutup sendi di bagian depan; ligamen ini paling lemah di antara ligamenta sacroiliaca.

desc.en: Very strong short fibres that fill the gap between the sacral and iliac tuberosities, behind and above the auricular surfaces.
desc.id: Serabut pendek yang sangat kuat, mengisi celah antara tuberositas ossis sacri dan tuberositas iliaca, di belakang atas facies auricularis.

attach.en: Tuberosity of the sacrum to the iliac tuberosity.
attach.id: Tuberositas ossis sacri ke tuberositas iliaca.

function.en: Main bond between sacrum and ilium; it forms the syndesmosis part of the joint and carries most of the weight passed from the sacrum to the hip bones.
function.id: Pengikat utama antara os sacrum dan os ilium; ligamen ini membentuk bagian syndesmosis sendi dan menanggung sebagian besar beban yang diteruskan dari os sacrum ke os coxae.

desc.en: Bands behind the interosseous ligament; the long fibres running down to the posterior superior iliac spine form the long posterior sacro-iliac ligament.
desc.id: Pita-pita di belakang lig. sacroiliacum interosseum; serabut panjang yang turun ke SIPS membentuk lig. sacroiliacum posterius longum.

attach.en: Intermediate and lateral sacral crests to the iliac tuberosity and the posterior superior iliac spine; the long part blends below with the sacrotuberous ligament.
attach.id: Crista sacralis medialis dan lateralis ke tuberositas iliaca dan SIPS; bagian panjangnya menyatu di bawah dengan lig. sacrotuberale.

function.en: Reinforces the back of the joint and helps hold the sacrum between the hip bones.
function.id: Memperkuat bagian belakang sendi dan membantu menahan os sacrum di antara kedua os coxae.

desc.en: Strong band from the transverse process of the fifth lumbar vertebra to the back of the iliac crest.
desc.id: Pita kuat dari processus transversus vertebra lumbalis V ke bagian belakang crista iliaca.

attach.en: Tip of the transverse process of L5 to the posterior part of the inner lip of the iliac crest; lower fibres reach the ala of the sacrum.
attach.id: Ujung processus transversus L5 ke bagian belakang labium internum crista iliaca; serabut bawahnya mencapai ala ossis sacri.

function.en: Ties L5 to the ilium, limits movement at the lumbosacral junction and supports the sacro-iliac joint.
function.id: Mengikat L5 ke os ilium, membatasi gerak pada perbatasan lumbosakral dan menopang articulatio sacroiliaca.

desc.en: Long strong band at the back of the pelvis, from the sacrum and posterior iliac spines to the ischial tuberosity.
desc.id: Pita panjang dan kuat di bagian belakang pelvis, dari os sacrum dan spina iliaca posterior ke tuber ischiadicum.

attach.en: Posterior iliac spines, lateral sacrum and coccyx to the medial margin of the ischial tuberosity; its lower edge continues forward on the ischial ramus as the falciform process.
attach.id: Spina iliaca posterior, sisi lateral os sacrum dan os coccygis ke tepi medial tuber ischiadicum; tepi bawahnya berlanjut ke depan pada ramus ossis ischii sebagai processus falciformis.

function.en: Stops the lower end of the sacrum tilting upward under body weight; with the sacrospinous ligament it closes the greater and lesser sciatic foramina. Part of gluteus maximus arises from it.
function.id: Mencegah ujung bawah os sacrum terangkat ke atas akibat berat badan; bersama lig. sacrospinale membentuk foramen ischiadicum majus dan minus. Sebagian m. gluteus maximus berorigo darinya.

desc.en: Thin triangular ligament in front of the sacrotuberous ligament, its pelvic surface covered by coccygeus.
desc.id: Ligamen tipis berbentuk segitiga di depan lig. sacrotuberale, dengan permukaan pelvisnya ditutupi m. coccygeus.

attach.en: Lateral margin of the lower sacrum and coccyx to the ischial spine.
attach.id: Tepi lateral os sacrum bagian bawah dan os coccygis ke spina ischiadica.

function.en: Helps the sacrotuberous ligament hold the lower sacrum down and separates the greater from the lesser sciatic foramen; the pudendal nerve crosses behind it near the spine.
function.id: Membantu lig. sacrotuberale menahan os sacrum bagian bawah dan memisahkan foramen ischiadicum majus dari foramen ischiadicum minus; n. pudendus menyilang di belakangnya dekat spina ischiadica.

desc.en: Thick band across the upper border of the pubic symphysis.
desc.id: Pita tebal yang melintang di tepi atas symphysis pubica.

attach.en: Upper margins of the symphysis, extending laterally to the pubic tubercles.
attach.id: Tepi atas symphysis, meluas ke lateral sampai tuberculum pubicum.

function.en: Reinforces the symphysis from above.
function.id: Memperkuat symphysis dari atas.

desc.en: Thick arched band along the lower border of the symphysis that rounds off the top of the pubic arch.
desc.id: Pita tebal melengkung di sepanjang tepi bawah symphysis yang membulatkan puncak arcus pubicus.

attach.en: Inferior pubic rami of both sides, blending with the interpubic disc.
attach.id: Ramus inferior ossis pubis kedua sisi, menyatu dengan discus interpubicus.

function.en: Strongest ligament of the symphysis; it forms the upper boundary of the subpubic angle.
function.id: Ligamen terkuat pada symphysis; membentuk batas atas angulus subpubicus.

desc.en: Fibrocartilaginous disc joining the hyaline-covered symphysial surfaces of the two pubic bones.
desc.id: Discus fibrocartilago yang menyatukan facies symphysialis kedua os pubis yang dilapisi cartilago hyalina.

attach.en: Symphysial surfaces of both pubic bones; it blends with the superior and inferior pubic ligaments.
attach.id: Facies symphysialis kedua os pubis; menyatu dengan lig. pubicum superius dan inferius.

function.en: Absorbs pressure and allows slight movement; it is usually thicker in women and often contains a small cavity.
function.id: Meredam tekanan dan memungkinkan sedikit gerak; biasanya lebih tebal pada perempuan dan sering memiliki rongga kecil.

desc.en: Y-shaped plate of hyaline cartilage in the acetabulum of a child, where the ilium, ischium and pubis meet.
desc.id: Lempeng cartilago hyalina berbentuk huruf Y di acetabulum anak, tempat os ilium, os ischii dan os pubis bertemu.

attach.en: Between the acetabular parts of the ilium, ischium and pubis.
attach.id: Di antara bagian acetabular os ilium, os ischii dan os pubis.

function.en: Growth plate of the acetabulum; it lets the socket grow with the femoral head and ossifies between about 15 and 25 years, when the three bones fuse.
function.id: Lempeng pertumbuhan acetabulum; memungkinkan soket tumbuh mengikuti caput femoris dan mengalami osifikasi sekitar usia 15-25 tahun, saat ketiga tulang menyatu.

desc.en: Fibrous sheet that closes the obturator foramen except at its upper end, where the obturator canal remains open.
desc.id: Lembaran fibrosa yang menutup foramen obturatum kecuali di ujung atasnya, tempat canalis obturatorius tetap terbuka.

attach.en: Margin of the obturator foramen, including the obturator tubercles.
attach.id: Tepi foramen obturatum, termasuk tuberculum obturatorium.

function.en: Gives origin to obturator internus on its inner surface and obturator externus on its outer surface; the obturator canal above it passes the obturator nerve and vessels.
function.id: Menjadi origo m. obturatorius internus pada permukaan dalam dan m. obturatorius externus pada permukaan luar; canalis obturatorius di atasnya dilalui n. obturatorius dan vasa obturatoria.

desc.en: Fibrocartilaginous ring, triangular in section, attached to the rim of the acetabulum.
desc.id: Cincin fibrocartilago berpenampang segitiga yang melekat pada tepi acetabulum.

attach.en: Acetabular margin; across the acetabular notch it continues as the transverse acetabular ligament.
attach.id: Margo acetabuli; di seberang incisura acetabuli berlanjut sebagai lig. transversum acetabuli.

function.en: Deepens the socket so that more than half of the femoral head is held, and seals the joint. Tears cause groin pain and catching.
function.id: Memperdalam soket sehingga lebih dari separuh caput femoris terpeluk, dan menyegel sendi. Robekannya menimbulkan nyeri lipat paha dan rasa tersangkut.

desc.en: Strong, loose fibrous sleeve from the acetabular rim to the neck of the femur, lined by synovial membrane.
desc.id: Selubung fibrosa yang kuat dan longgar dari tepi acetabulum ke collum femoris, dilapisi membrana synovialis.

attach.en: Proximally the acetabular margin, labrum and transverse acetabular ligament. Distally the intertrochanteric line in front; behind, the neck about 1 cm above the intertrochanteric crest.
attach.id: Proksimal: margo acetabuli, labrum dan lig. transversum acetabuli. Distal: linea intertrochanterica di depan; di belakang, collum femoris sekitar 1 cm di atas crista intertrochanterica.

function.en: Its longitudinal fibres form the iliofemoral, pubofemoral and ischiofemoral ligaments, and its deep circular fibres (zona orbicularis) grip the neck.
function.id: Serabut longitudinalnya membentuk lig. iliofemorale, lig. pubofemorale dan lig. ischiofemorale, sedangkan serabut sirkular bagian dalamnya (zona orbicularis) melingkari collum femoris.

desc.en: Medial, nearly vertical limb of the Y-shaped iliofemoral ligament (ligament of Bigelow) on the front of the hip joint.
desc.id: Kaki medial lig. iliofemorale berbentuk huruf Y (ligamen Bigelow) yang hampir vertikal di depan sendi panggul.

attach.en: Anterior inferior iliac spine and acetabular rim to the lower part of the intertrochanteric line.
attach.id: SIAI dan tepi acetabulum ke bagian bawah linea intertrochanterica.

function.en: With the transverse part it prevents hyperextension of the hip, so a person can stand upright with little muscle work.
function.id: Bersama pars transversa mencegah hiperekstensi sendi panggul, sehingga seseorang dapat berdiri tegak dengan sedikit kerja otot.

desc.en: Upper lateral limb of the Y-shaped iliofemoral ligament.
desc.id: Kaki lateral atas lig. iliofemorale yang berbentuk huruf Y.

attach.en: Anterior inferior iliac spine and acetabular rim to the upper part of the intertrochanteric line near the greater trochanter.
attach.id: SIAI dan tepi acetabulum ke bagian atas linea intertrochanterica di dekat trochanter major.

function.en: Limits extension, adduction and lateral rotation of the hip.
function.id: Membatasi ekstensi, adduksi dan rotasi lateral sendi panggul.

desc.en: Longitudinal folds of synovial membrane and deep capsular fibres reflected back along the femoral neck from the distal attachment of the capsule.
desc.id: Lipatan longitudinal membrana synovialis dan serabut kapsul bagian dalam yang membalik ke arah proksimal di sepanjang collum femoris dari perlekatan distal capsula.

attach.en: From the distal capsular attachment on the neck toward the margin of the femoral head.
attach.id: Dari perlekatan distal capsula pada collum ke arah tepi caput femoris.

function.en: They carry the retinacular arteries, mainly from the medial circumflex femoral artery, that supply the head and neck of the femur.
function.id: Membawa arteri retinakular, terutama dari a. circumflexa femoris medialis, yang memperdarahi caput dan collum femoris.

desc.en: Weakest of the three capsular ligaments, on the back of the hip joint.
desc.id: Ligamen kapsul yang paling lemah di antara ketiganya, terletak di belakang sendi panggul.

attach.en: Ischial part of the acetabular rim, spiralling upward and laterally to the neck of the femur medial to the base of the greater trochanter.
attach.id: Bagian ischiadica tepi acetabulum, berjalan spiral ke atas lateral ke collum femoris di medial pangkal trochanter major.

function.en: Tightens in extension and limits medial rotation.
function.id: Menegang saat ekstensi dan membatasi rotasi medial.

desc.en: Weak flattened band inside the joint, covered by synovial membrane.
desc.id: Pita pipih dan lemah di dalam sendi yang dibungkus membrana synovialis.

attach.en: Margins of the acetabular notch and the transverse acetabular ligament to the fovea of the femoral head.
attach.id: Tepi incisura acetabuli dan lig. transversum acetabuli ke fovea capitis femoris.

function.en: Adds little to stability; it carries a small branch of the obturator artery to the head, important mainly in children.
function.id: Hanya sedikit menambah kestabilan; membawa cabang kecil a. obturatoria ke caput femoris, yang terutama penting pada anak.

desc.en: Triangular band on the anteroinferior side of the hip capsule.
desc.id: Pita berbentuk segitiga di sisi anteroinferior capsula articularis coxae.

attach.en: Obturator crest and superior pubic ramus to the capsule, blending with the medial part of the iliofemoral ligament.
attach.id: Crista obturatoria dan ramus superior ossis pubis ke capsula articularis, menyatu dengan bagian medial lig. iliofemorale.

function.en: Tightens in extension and abduction and prevents overabduction of the hip.
function.id: Menegang saat ekstensi dan abduksi serta mencegah abduksi berlebihan sendi panggul.

desc.en: Part of the acetabular labrum that bridges the acetabular notch.
desc.id: Bagian labrum acetabuli yang menjembatani incisura acetabuli.

attach.en: Across the acetabular notch, between its two margins.
attach.id: Melintang di atas incisura acetabuli, di antara kedua tepinya.

function.en: Completes the rim of the socket and turns the notch into a foramen through which vessels and nerves enter the joint; the ligament of the head arises partly from it.
function.id: Melengkapi tepi soket dan mengubah incisura menjadi lubang tempat masuknya pembuluh darah dan saraf ke dalam sendi; lig. capitis femoris sebagian berasal darinya.

desc.en: Intracapsular but extrasynovial ligament running upward, backward and laterally from the front of the tibia to the lateral femoral condyle.
desc.id: Ligamen intrakapsular tetapi ekstrasinovial yang berjalan ke atas, belakang dan lateral dari bagian depan tibia ke condylus lateralis femoris.

attach.en: Anterior intercondylar area of the tibia, just behind the medial meniscus, to the posterior part of the medial surface of the lateral femoral condyle.
attach.id: Area intercondylaris anterior tibiae, tepat di belakang meniscus medialis, ke bagian belakang permukaan medial condylus lateralis femoris.

function.en: Prevents the tibia sliding forward on the femur and limits hyperextension. It is the weaker cruciate and is often torn by twisting on a planted foot (anterior drawer and Lachman tests).
function.id: Mencegah tibia bergeser ke depan terhadap femur dan membatasi hiperekstensi. Ligamen ini lebih lemah daripada lig. cruciatum posterius dan sering robek saat tubuh berputar dengan kaki tertumpu (uji anterior drawer dan Lachman).

desc.en: Stronger of the two cruciate ligaments, running upward and forward from the back of the tibia to the medial femoral condyle.
desc.id: Ligamen cruciatum yang lebih kuat, berjalan ke atas dan depan dari bagian belakang tibia ke condylus medialis femoris.

attach.en: Posterior intercondylar area of the tibia, extending onto its posterior surface, to the anterior part of the lateral surface of the medial femoral condyle.
attach.id: Area intercondylaris posterior tibiae yang meluas ke facies posterior, ke bagian depan permukaan lateral condylus medialis femoris.

function.en: Prevents the tibia sliding backward on the femur and the femur sliding forward on the tibia; it is the main stabilizer of the flexed, weight-bearing knee, as in walking downhill.
function.id: Mencegah tibia bergeser ke belakang terhadap femur dan femur bergeser ke depan terhadap tibia; ligamen ini penstabil utama lutut yang fleksi sambil menahan beban, misalnya saat berjalan menuruni bukit.

en: Anterior meniscotibial ligament of medial meniscus

desc.en: Fibrous attachment (anterior root) that anchors the anterior horn of the medial meniscus to the tibia.
desc.id: Perlekatan fibrosa (radiks anterior) yang menambatkan cornu anterius meniscus medialis ke tibia.

attach.en: Anterior horn of the medial meniscus to the front of the anterior intercondylar area, in front of the anterior cruciate ligament.
attach.id: Cornu anterius meniscus medialis ke bagian depan area intercondylaris anterior, di depan lig. cruciatum anterius.

function.en: Fixes the horn so the meniscus can resist being pushed outward by the femoral condyle under load. Some authors also call the capsular fibres that tie the outer meniscal margins to the tibia meniscotibial (coronary) ligaments.
function.id: Menambatkan cornu sehingga meniscus dapat menahan dorongan condylus femoris ke arah luar saat menerima beban. Sebagian penulis juga menyebut serabut kapsul yang mengikat tepi luar meniscus ke tibia sebagai lig. meniscotibiale (lig. coronarium).

en: Anterior meniscotibial ligament of lateral meniscus

desc.en: Fibrous attachment (anterior root) of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus to the tibia.
desc.id: Perlekatan fibrosa (radiks anterior) cornu anterius meniscus lateralis ke tibia.

attach.en: Anterior horn of the lateral meniscus to the anterior intercondylar area in front of the intercondylar eminence, beside and behind the attachment of the anterior cruciate ligament.
attach.id: Cornu anterius meniscus lateralis ke area intercondylaris anterior di depan eminentia intercondylaris, di samping belakang perlekatan lig. cruciatum anterius.

function.en: Anchors the anterior horn while leaving the lateral meniscus more mobile than the medial one.
function.id: Menambatkan cornu anterius dengan tetap membiarkan meniscus lateralis lebih mudah bergerak daripada meniscus medialis.

en: Posterior meniscotibial ligament of medial meniscus

desc.en: Fibrous attachment (posterior root) of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus to the tibia.
desc.id: Perlekatan fibrosa (radiks posterior) cornu posterius meniscus medialis ke tibia.

attach.en: Posterior horn of the medial meniscus to the posterior intercondylar area, in front of the posterior cruciate ligament.
attach.id: Cornu posterius meniscus medialis ke area intercondylaris posterior, di depan lig. cruciatum posterius.

function.en: Anchors the broad posterior horn, which carries much of the load in flexion; a tear of this root lets the meniscus extrude and lose its load-bearing function.
function.id: Menambatkan cornu posterius yang lebar, yang menanggung banyak beban saat fleksi; robekan radiks ini membuat meniscus terdorong keluar dan kehilangan fungsi penahan bebannya.

en: Posterior meniscotibial ligament of lateral meniscus

desc.en: Fibrous attachment (posterior root) of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus to the tibia.
desc.id: Perlekatan fibrosa (radiks posterior) cornu posterius meniscus lateralis ke tibia.

attach.en: Posterior horn of the lateral meniscus to the posterior intercondylar area just behind the intercondylar eminence, in front of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
attach.id: Cornu posterius meniscus lateralis ke area intercondylaris posterior tepat di belakang eminentia intercondylaris, di depan cornu posterius meniscus medialis.

function.en: Anchors the posterior horn; the posterior meniscofemoral ligament also ties this horn to the medial femoral condyle.
function.id: Menambatkan cornu posterius; lig. meniscofemorale posterius juga mengikat cornu ini ke condylus medialis femoris.

desc.en: Y-shaped thickening of the posterolateral capsule that arches over the tendon of popliteus.
desc.id: Penebalan capsula bagian posterolateral berbentuk huruf Y yang melengkung di atas tendo m. popliteus.

attach.en: Posterior aspect of the head of the fibula, spreading upward and medially over the popliteus tendon into the posterior capsule.
attach.id: Sisi posterior caput fibulae, menyebar ke atas medial di atas tendo m. popliteus ke bagian posterior capsula articularis.

function.en: Strengthens the posterolateral corner of the capsule.
function.id: Memperkuat sudut posterolateral capsula articularis.

desc.en: Fibrous capsule of the knee, incomplete in front, where the patella, quadriceps tendon and patellar ligament take its place; its synovial lining is the most extensive in the body.
desc.id: Capsula fibrosa sendi lutut yang tidak lengkap di depan, tempat patella, tendo quadriceps dan lig. patellae menggantikannya; membrana synovialis-nya paling luas di tubuh.

attach.en: Femur: margins of the condyles and the intercondylar line. Tibia: margins of the condyles. Front: sides of the patella. An opening at the back lets the popliteus tendon out.
attach.id: Femur: tepi condylus dan linea intercondylaris. Tibia: tepi condylus. Depan: sisi patella. Lubang di belakang menjadi jalan keluar tendo m. popliteus.

function.en: Encloses the joint; it is reinforced by the collateral ligaments, the oblique and arcuate popliteal ligaments and the patellar retinacula, and its synovial membrane extends upward as the suprapatellar bursa.
function.id: Membungkus sendi; diperkuat oleh ligamenta collateralia, lig. popliteum obliquum dan arcuatum serta retinaculum patellae, dan membrana synovialis-nya meluas ke atas sebagai bursa suprapatellaris.

en: Deep part of tibial collateral ligament

desc.en: Short deep layer of the medial collateral ligament, a thickening of the capsule firmly joined to the medial meniscus.
desc.id: Lapisan dalam lig. collaterale mediale yang pendek, merupakan penebalan capsula yang melekat erat pada meniscus medialis.

attach.en: Medial epicondyle of the femur to the margin of the medial tibial condyle, attached on the way to the periphery of the medial meniscus.
attach.id: Epicondylus medialis femoris ke tepi condylus medialis tibiae, dan sepanjang jalannya melekat pada tepi luar meniscus medialis.

function.en: Ties the medial meniscus to the capsule; this makes the meniscus less mobile and explains why it often tears together with the ligament.
function.id: Mengikat meniscus medialis ke capsula; hal ini membuat meniscus kurang mobil dan menjelaskan mengapa meniscus sering ikut robek bersama ligamen ini.

en: Superficial part of tibial collateral ligament

desc.en: Long flat band on the medial side of the knee, the main part of the tibial (medial) collateral ligament.
desc.id: Pita panjang dan pipih di sisi medial lutut, bagian utama lig. collaterale tibiale (mediale).

attach.en: Medial epicondyle of the femur to the medial surface of the tibia several centimetres below the joint line, behind and deep to the pes anserinus.
attach.id: Epicondylus medialis femoris ke facies medialis tibiae beberapa sentimeter di bawah garis sendi, di belakang dan di bawah pes anserinus.

function.en: Resists valgus (abduction) stress and lateral rotation of the tibia; it is tight in extension.
function.id: Menahan tekanan valgus (abduksi) dan rotasi lateral tibia; ligamen ini tegang saat ekstensi.

desc.en: Round, cord-like ligament on the lateral side of the knee, separate from the capsule.
desc.id: Ligamen bulat seperti tali di sisi lateral lutut yang terpisah dari capsula articularis.

attach.en: Lateral epicondyle of the femur to the lateral surface of the head of the fibula; the biceps femoris tendon splits around its lower end.
attach.id: Epicondylus lateralis femoris ke permukaan lateral caput fibulae; tendo m. biceps femoris terbelah mengapit ujung bawahnya.

function.en: Resists varus (adduction) stress and is tight in extension. The popliteus tendon passes deep to it and separates it from the lateral meniscus.
function.id: Menahan tekanan varus (adduksi) dan tegang saat ekstensi. Tendo m. popliteus lewat di bawahnya dan memisahkannya dari meniscus lateralis.

desc.en: Pad of fat behind the patellar ligament, inside the capsule but outside the synovial membrane, which it pushes into the joint as the infrapatellar and alar folds.
desc.id: Bantalan lemak di belakang lig. patellae, di dalam capsula articularis tetapi di luar membrana synovialis, yang didorongnya ke dalam sendi sebagai plica synovialis infrapatellaris dan plicae alares.

attach.en: Lies between the patellar ligament in front and the femoral condyles and anterior intercondylar area behind.
attach.id: Terletak di antara lig. patellae di depan serta condylus femoris dan area intercondylaris anterior di belakang.

function.en: Fills the space in front of the joint as it changes shape in flexion and extension and helps spread synovial fluid; it can be pinched and become painful (Hoffa syndrome).
function.id: Mengisi ruang di depan sendi yang berubah bentuk saat fleksi dan ekstensi serta membantu menyebarkan cairan sinovial; bantalan ini dapat terjepit dan menimbulkan nyeri (sindrom Hoffa).

desc.en: Nearly circular fibrocartilage on the lateral tibial condyle, smaller and more mobile than the medial meniscus.
desc.id: Fibrocartilago yang hampir berbentuk lingkaran pada condylus lateralis tibiae, lebih kecil dan lebih mudah bergerak daripada meniscus medialis.

attach.en: Its horns attach close together in front of and behind the intercondylar eminence; the meniscofemoral ligaments join its posterior horn to the medial femoral condyle, and some fibres of popliteus attach to it.
attach.id: Kedua cornu-nya melekat berdekatan di depan dan di belakang eminentia intercondylaris; ligamenta meniscofemoralia menghubungkan cornu posterius-nya ke condylus medialis femoris, dan sebagian serabut m. popliteus melekat padanya.

function.en: Deepens the lateral tibial surface, spreads load and absorbs shock. Because it is not attached to the fibular collateral ligament and popliteus draws it back, it is torn less often.
function.id: Memperdalam permukaan lateral tibia, menyebarkan beban dan meredam guncangan. Karena tidak melekat pada lig. collaterale fibulare dan ditarik ke belakang oleh m. popliteus, meniscus ini lebih jarang robek.

desc.en: C-shaped fibrocartilage on the medial tibial condyle, broader behind than in front.
desc.id: Fibrocartilago berbentuk huruf C pada condylus medialis tibiae, lebih lebar di belakang daripada di depan.

attach.en: Anterior horn in front of the anterior cruciate ligament, posterior horn in front of the posterior cruciate ligament; its outer margin is firmly fixed to the capsule and the deep part of the tibial collateral ligament.
attach.id: Cornu anterius di depan lig. cruciatum anterius, cornu posterius di depan lig. cruciatum posterius; tepi luarnya melekat erat pada capsula dan pars profunda lig. collateralis tibialis.

function.en: Improves the fit between the femoral and tibial condyles and spreads load; being less mobile, it is torn more often than the lateral meniscus.
function.id: Meningkatkan kesesuaian condylus femoris dan tibiae serta menyebarkan beban; karena kurang mobil, meniscus ini lebih sering robek daripada meniscus lateralis.

desc.en: Thickening of the anterior capsule, deep to the patellar retinaculum, running from the side of the patella to the anterior part of the meniscus.
desc.id: Penebalan capsula bagian anterior di bawah retinaculum patellae, berjalan dari sisi patella ke bagian depan meniscus.

attach.en: Lateral or medial border of the patella to the anterior horn and margin of the meniscus.
attach.id: Tepi lateral atau medial patella ke cornu anterius dan tepi meniscus.

function.en: Draws the meniscus forward as the knee extends.
function.id: Menarik meniscus ke depan saat lutut ekstensi.

desc.en: Expansion of the semimembranosus tendon that crosses the back of the capsule obliquely upward and laterally.
desc.id: Perluasan tendo m. semimembranosus yang menyilang bagian belakang capsula secara miring ke atas lateral.

attach.en: Behind the medial tibial condyle to the central posterior capsule and the intercondylar line, toward the lateral femoral condyle.
attach.id: Dari belakang condylus medialis tibiae ke bagian tengah posterior capsula dan linea intercondylaris, ke arah condylus lateralis femoris.

function.en: Strengthens the posterior capsule and limits hyperextension; the popliteal artery lies on it in the floor of the popliteal fossa.
function.id: Memperkuat capsula bagian posterior dan membatasi hiperekstensi; a. poplitea terletak di atasnya pada dasar fossa poplitea.

desc.en: Short strong band from the popliteus tendon to the fibular head, part of the posterolateral corner of the knee.
desc.id: Pita pendek dan kuat dari tendo m. popliteus ke caput fibulae, bagian dari sudut posterolateral lutut.

attach.en: Popliteus tendon near its musculotendinous junction to the posterior part of the apex of the head of the fibula.
attach.id: Tendo m. popliteus di dekat peralihan otot-tendo ke bagian posterior apex capitis fibulae.

function.en: Limits lateral rotation of the tibia and backward shift of the lateral tibial condyle; it is damaged in posterolateral corner injuries.
function.id: Membatasi rotasi lateral tibia dan pergeseran condylus lateralis tibiae ke belakang; ligamen ini rusak pada cedera sudut posterolateral.

desc.en: Short band joining the anterior margins of the medial and lateral menisci.
desc.id: Pita pendek yang menghubungkan tepi anterior meniscus medialis dan lateralis.

attach.en: Anterior horn of the medial meniscus to the anterior margin of the lateral meniscus.
attach.id: Cornu anterius meniscus medialis ke tepi anterior meniscus lateralis.

function.en: Lets the two menisci move together during knee movements.
function.id: Memungkinkan kedua meniscus bergerak bersama saat lutut bergerak.

desc.en: Flat bands across the front of the superior tibiofibular joint.
desc.id: Pita-pita pipih yang melintang di depan articulatio tibiofibularis.

attach.en: Front of the head of the fibula, upward and medially to the front of the lateral tibial condyle.
attach.id: Bagian depan caput fibulae, ke atas medial ke bagian depan condylus lateralis tibiae.

function.en: Reinforces the capsule in front.
function.id: Memperkuat capsula di bagian depan.

desc.en: Single thick band behind the superior tibiofibular joint, covered by the popliteus tendon.
desc.id: Satu pita tebal di belakang articulatio tibiofibularis yang tertutup tendo m. popliteus.

attach.en: Back of the head of the fibula, upward and medially to the back of the lateral tibial condyle.
attach.id: Bagian belakang caput fibulae, ke atas medial ke bagian belakang condylus lateralis tibiae.

function.en: Reinforces the capsule behind.
function.id: Memperkuat capsula di bagian belakang.

en: Articular capsule of superior tibiofibular joint

desc.en: Fibrous capsule around the facets of the fibular head and lateral tibial condyle, thicker in front than behind.
desc.id: Capsula fibrosa yang mengelilingi faset caput fibulae dan condylus lateralis tibiae, lebih tebal di depan daripada di belakang.

attach.en: Margins of the articular facets on the fibular head and on the lateral tibial condyle.
attach.id: Tepi facies articularis pada caput fibulae dan pada condylus lateralis tibiae.

function.en: Encloses the joint; in some people its synovial cavity communicates with the knee through the subpopliteal recess.
function.id: Membungkus sendi; pada sebagian orang rongga sinovialnya berhubungan dengan sendi lutut melalui recessus subpopliteus.

desc.en: Flat band across the front of the distal tibiofibular syndesmosis.
desc.id: Pita pipih yang melintang di depan syndesmosis tibiofibularis distal.

attach.en: Anterior margin of the fibular notch of the tibia, downward and laterally to the front of the lateral malleolus.
attach.id: Tepi anterior incisura fibularis tibiae, ke bawah lateral ke bagian depan malleolus lateralis.

function.en: Holds the fibula against the tibia at the front of the mortise; it is the ligament usually torn in a high ankle sprain.
function.id: Menahan fibula tetap menempel pada tibia di bagian depan soket; ligamen inilah yang biasanya robek pada high ankle sprain.

desc.en: Strong band behind the distal tibiofibular syndesmosis.
desc.id: Pita kuat di belakang syndesmosis tibiofibularis distal.

attach.en: Posterior margin of the fibular notch of the tibia to the back of the lateral malleolus.
attach.id: Tepi posterior incisura fibularis tibiae ke bagian belakang malleolus lateralis.

function.en: Holds the bones together behind. It is stronger than the anterior ligament, so a violent force often pulls off the posterior malleolus instead of tearing it.
function.id: Menyatukan kedua tulang di belakang. Ligamen ini lebih kuat daripada lig. tibiofibulare anterius, sehingga gaya yang hebat sering menarik lepas malleolus posterior alih-alih merobek ligamen ini.

desc.en: Deep lower part of the posterior tibiofibular ligament, which projects below the back edge of the tibia.
desc.id: Bagian bawah dalam lig. tibiofibulare posterius yang menonjol di bawah tepi belakang tibia.

attach.en: Malleolar fossa of the fibula to the posterior border of the inferior articular surface of the tibia.
attach.id: Fossa malleoli lateralis fibulae ke tepi posterior facies articularis inferior tibiae.

function.en: Deepens the ankle socket behind, where it articulates with the back of the talar trochlea.
function.id: Memperdalam soket pergelangan kaki di belakang, tempat ligamen ini bersentuhan dengan bagian belakang trochlea tali.

desc.en: Lateral ligament of the ankle, made of three separate bands from the lateral malleolus: the anterior talofibular, calcaneofibular and posterior talofibular ligaments.
desc.id: Ligamen lateral pergelangan kaki yang terdiri atas tiga pita terpisah dari malleolus lateralis: lig. talofibulare anterius, lig. calcaneofibulare dan lig. talofibulare posterius.

attach.en: Lateral malleolus to the neck and lateral tubercle of the talus and to the lateral surface of the calcaneus.
attach.id: Malleolus lateralis ke collum dan tuberculum laterale tali serta ke permukaan lateral calcaneus.

function.en: Resists inversion, especially in plantarflexion; it is much weaker than the deltoid ligament and is the ligament injured in the common inversion sprain.
function.id: Menahan inversi, terutama saat plantarfleksi; ligamen ini jauh lebih lemah daripada lig. deltoideum dan menjadi ligamen yang cedera pada keseleo inversi yang sering terjadi.

desc.en: Strong triangular ligament that fans out from the medial malleolus to the navicular, the sustentaculum tali and the talus, with tibionavicular, tibiocalcaneal and anterior and posterior tibiotalar parts.
desc.id: Ligamen segitiga yang kuat, menyebar dari malleolus medialis ke os naviculare, sustentaculum tali dan talus, dengan pars tibionavicularis, pars tibiocalcanea serta pars tibiotalaris anterior dan posterior.

attach.en: Apex and borders of the medial malleolus to the tuberosity of the navicular and the plantar calcaneonavicular ligament, the sustentaculum tali, and the medial side of the talus.
attach.id: Apex dan tepi malleolus medialis ke tuberositas ossis navicularis dan lig. calcaneonaviculare plantare, sustentaculum tali, serta sisi medial talus.

function.en: Resists eversion and holds the talus in the mortise; it is so strong that forced eversion usually breaks off the medial malleolus before the ligament tears.
function.id: Menahan eversi dan menjaga talus tetap di dalam soket; ligamen ini sangat kuat sehingga eversi paksa biasanya mematahkan malleolus medialis lebih dahulu sebelum ligamennya robek.

desc.en: Weak flat band, part of the lateral ligament of the ankle.
desc.id: Pita pipih yang lemah, bagian dari lig. collaterale laterale pergelangan kaki.

attach.en: Anterior border of the lateral malleolus to the lateral side of the neck of the talus.
attach.id: Tepi anterior malleolus lateralis ke sisi lateral collum tali.

function.en: Limits forward displacement of the talus and inversion in plantarflexion; it is the most commonly injured ligament of the ankle (anterior drawer test).
function.id: Membatasi pergeseran talus ke depan dan inversi saat plantarfleksi; ligamen pergelangan kaki yang paling sering cedera (uji anterior drawer).

desc.en: Round cord of the lateral ligament of the ankle, crossing both the ankle and subtalar joints deep to the fibularis tendons.
desc.id: Tali bulat bagian lig. collaterale laterale pergelangan kaki yang menyilang sendi pergelangan kaki dan sendi subtalar di bawah tendo-tendo m. fibularis.

attach.en: Tip of the lateral malleolus downward and backward to the lateral surface of the calcaneus.
attach.id: Ujung malleolus lateralis ke bawah belakang ke permukaan lateral calcaneus.

function.en: Resists inversion; it is torn after the anterior talofibular ligament in more severe sprains.
function.id: Menahan inversi; ligamen ini robek setelah lig. talofibulare anterius pada keseleo yang lebih berat.

desc.en: Thick strong band of the lateral ligament running almost horizontally behind the ankle.
desc.id: Pita tebal dan kuat bagian lig. collaterale laterale yang berjalan hampir horizontal di belakang pergelangan kaki.

attach.en: Malleolar fossa of the fibula medially and backward to the lateral tubercle of the posterior process of the talus.
attach.id: Fossa malleoli lateralis fibulae ke medial belakang menuju tuberculum laterale processus posterioris tali.

function.en: Resists backward displacement and lateral rotation of the talus; it is rarely torn.
function.id: Menahan pergeseran talus ke belakang dan rotasi lateralnya; ligamen ini jarang robek.

en: Posterior tibiotalar part of deltoid ligament

desc.en: Thick deep posterior part of the deltoid ligament.
desc.id: Bagian posterior lig. deltoideum yang tebal dan terletak dalam.

attach.en: Medial malleolus to the medial side of the talus and its medial tubercle.
attach.id: Malleolus medialis ke sisi medial talus dan tuberculum mediale-nya.

function.en: Holds the talus against the medial malleolus and resists eversion and lateral rotation of the talus.
function.id: Menahan talus tetap menempel pada malleolus medialis serta menahan eversi dan rotasi lateral talus.

desc.en: Middle superficial part of the deltoid ligament, running almost vertically.
desc.id: Bagian tengah superfisial lig. deltoideum yang berjalan hampir vertikal.

attach.en: Medial malleolus to the sustentaculum tali.
attach.id: Malleolus medialis ke sustentaculum tali.

function.en: Resists eversion; it also crosses and steadies the subtalar joint.
function.id: Menahan eversi; bagian ini juga menyilang dan menstabilkan articulatio subtalaris.

desc.en: Anterior superficial part of the deltoid ligament.
desc.id: Bagian anterior superfisial lig. deltoideum.

attach.en: Medial malleolus to the tuberosity of the navicular, blending with the plantar calcaneonavicular ligament.
attach.id: Malleolus medialis ke tuberositas ossis navicularis, menyatu dengan lig. calcaneonaviculare plantare.

function.en: Resists eversion and abduction of the foot and, with the spring ligament, supports the head of the talus.
function.id: Menahan eversi dan abduksi kaki serta, bersama spring ligament, menyangga caput tali.

desc.en: Short band in front of the subtalar joint, in the tarsal sinus.
desc.id: Pita pendek di depan articulatio subtalaris, di dalam sinus tarsi.

attach.en: Neck of the talus to the upper surface of the calcaneus in the tarsal sinus.
attach.id: Collum tali ke permukaan atas calcaneus di dalam sinus tarsi.

function.en: Reinforces the front of the subtalar joint; it is often described as part of the talocalcaneal interosseous ligament.
function.id: Memperkuat bagian depan articulatio subtalaris; sering dianggap sebagai bagian lig. talocalcaneum interosseum.

desc.en: Short flat band on the lateral side of the subtalar joint, in front of and parallel to the calcaneofibular ligament.
desc.id: Pita pendek dan pipih di sisi lateral articulatio subtalaris, di depan dan sejajar dengan lig. calcaneofibulare.

attach.en: Lateral process of the talus downward and backward to the lateral surface of the calcaneus.
attach.id: Processus lateralis tali ke bawah belakang ke permukaan lateral calcaneus.

function.en: Reinforces the lateral side of the subtalar joint.
function.id: Memperkuat sisi lateral articulatio subtalaris.

desc.en: Band on the medial side of the subtalar joint.
desc.id: Pita di sisi medial articulatio subtalaris.

attach.en: Medial tubercle of the talus to the back of the sustentaculum tali.
attach.id: Tuberculum mediale tali ke bagian belakang sustentaculum tali.

function.en: Reinforces the medial side of the subtalar joint.
function.id: Memperkuat sisi medial articulatio subtalaris.

desc.en: Short fibres closing the back of the subtalar joint.
desc.id: Serabut pendek yang menutup bagian belakang articulatio subtalaris.

attach.en: Lateral tubercle of the posterior process of the talus to the upper medial part of the calcaneus.
attach.id: Tuberculum laterale processus posterioris tali ke bagian atas medial calcaneus.

function.en: Reinforces the back of the subtalar joint.
function.id: Memperkuat bagian belakang articulatio subtalaris.

desc.en: Strong band in the tarsal sinus and canal, between the subtalar and talocalcaneonavicular joints.
desc.id: Pita kuat di dalam sinus dan canalis tarsi, di antara articulatio subtalaris dan articulatio talocalcaneonavicularis.

attach.en: Sulcus tali to the sulcus calcanei.
attach.id: Sulcus tali ke sulcus calcanei.

function.en: Main bond between the talus and calcaneus; it separates the two joints and lies close to the axis of inversion and eversion.
function.id: Pengikat utama antara talus dan calcaneus; ligamen ini memisahkan kedua sendi dan terletak dekat sumbu gerak inversi dan eversi.

desc.en: Broad thin band on the dorsum of the foot over the talonavicular joint.
desc.id: Pita lebar dan tipis di dorsum kaki di atas sendi talonavicularis.

attach.en: Neck of the talus to the dorsal surface of the navicular.
attach.id: Collum tali ke permukaan dorsal os naviculare.

function.en: Reinforces the talonavicular part of the talocalcaneonavicular joint from above.
function.id: Memperkuat bagian talonavicularis articulatio talocalcaneonavicularis dari atas.

desc.en: Medial limb of the Y-shaped bifurcate ligament on the dorsum of the foot.
desc.id: Kaki medial lig. bifurcatum yang berbentuk huruf Y di dorsum kaki.

attach.en: Upper surface of the anterior process of the calcaneus to the dorsolateral side of the navicular.
attach.id: Permukaan atas processus anterior calcanei ke sisi dorsolateral os naviculare.

function.en: Binds the calcaneus to the navicular across the transverse tarsal joint and lines the lateral side of the socket for the head of the talus.
function.id: Mengikat calcaneus ke os naviculare melintasi articulatio tarsi transversa dan melapisi sisi lateral soket caput tali.

desc.en: Lateral limb of the bifurcate ligament on the dorsum of the foot.
desc.id: Kaki lateral lig. bifurcatum di dorsum kaki.

attach.en: Anterior process of the calcaneus to the dorsomedial side of the cuboid.
attach.id: Processus anterior calcanei ke sisi dorsomedial os cuboideum.

function.en: Joins the calcaneus to the cuboid on the dorsal side of the calcaneocuboid joint; an inversion injury can tear it or avulse its bony origin.
function.id: Menghubungkan calcaneus dengan os cuboideum di sisi dorsal articulatio calcaneocuboidea; cedera inversi dapat merobeknya atau menarik lepas tulang tempat asalnya.

desc.en: Thin broad band on the dorsolateral side of the calcaneocuboid joint.
desc.id: Pita tipis dan lebar di sisi dorsolateral articulatio calcaneocuboidea.

attach.en: Dorsal surface of the calcaneus to the dorsal surface of the cuboid.
attach.id: Permukaan dorsal calcaneus ke permukaan dorsal os cuboideum.

function.en: Reinforces the capsule from above.
function.id: Memperkuat capsula dari atas.

desc.en: Short wide band in the sole, lying deeper than the long plantar ligament.
desc.id: Pita pendek dan lebar di telapak kaki, terletak lebih dalam daripada lig. plantare longum.

attach.en: Calcaneal tubercle at the front of the plantar surface of the calcaneus to the plantar surface of the cuboid behind its groove.
attach.id: Tuberculum calcanei di bagian depan facies plantaris calcanei ke facies plantaris os cuboideum di belakang alurnya.

function.en: Holds the calcaneocuboid joint from below and supports the lateral longitudinal arch.
function.id: Menopang articulatio calcaneocuboidea dari bawah dan menyangga lengkung longitudinal lateral.

desc.en: Longest ligament of the sole, running forward from the calcaneus to the cuboid and the bases of the lateral metatarsals.
desc.id: Ligamen terpanjang di telapak kaki, berjalan ke depan dari calcaneus ke os cuboideum dan basis os metatarsi bagian lateral.

attach.en: Plantar surface of the calcaneus in front of the processes of its tuberosity to the tuberosity of the cuboid, with superficial fibres reaching the bases of the second or third to fifth metatarsals.
attach.id: Facies plantaris calcanei di depan processus tuber calcanei ke tuberositas ossis cuboidei, dengan serabut superfisial yang mencapai basis os metatarsi II atau III sampai V.

function.en: Supports the lateral longitudinal arch and converts the cuboid groove into a tunnel for the tendon of fibularis longus.
function.id: Menyangga lengkung longitudinal lateral dan mengubah alur os cuboideum menjadi terowongan bagi tendo m. fibularis longus.

desc.en: Thick fibrocartilaginous band that forms the floor of the socket for the head of the talus.
desc.id: Pita fibrocartilago yang tebal, membentuk dasar soket bagi caput tali.

attach.en: Anterior margin of the sustentaculum tali to the plantar surface and tuberosity of the navicular.
attach.id: Tepi anterior sustentaculum tali ke facies plantaris dan tuberositas ossis navicularis.

function.en: Supports the head of the talus and the medial longitudinal arch; the tibialis posterior tendon lies just below it and helps carry the load.
function.id: Menyangga caput tali dan lengkung longitudinal medial; tendo m. tibialis posterior terletak tepat di bawahnya dan ikut menanggung beban.

desc.en: Short oblique band on the dorsum between the navicular and the cuboid.
desc.id: Pita pendek dan miring di dorsum di antara os naviculare dan os cuboideum.

attach.en: Dorsal surface of the navicular to the dorsal surface of the cuboid.
attach.id: Permukaan dorsal os naviculare ke permukaan dorsal os cuboideum.

function.en: Binds the navicular and cuboid, which are usually joined only by ligaments and sometimes by a small synovial joint.
function.id: Mengikat os naviculare dan os cuboideum, yang biasanya hanya dihubungkan oleh ligamen dan kadang-kadang oleh sendi sinovial kecil.

desc.en: Transverse band on the plantar side between the navicular and the cuboid.
desc.id: Pita melintang di sisi plantar di antara os naviculare dan os cuboideum.

attach.en: Plantar surface of the navicular to the medial plantar surface of the cuboid.
attach.id: Permukaan plantar os naviculare ke permukaan plantar medial os cuboideum.

function.en: Binds the two bones from below and helps hold the transverse arch.
function.id: Mengikat kedua tulang dari bawah dan membantu mempertahankan lengkung transversal.

desc.en: Flat band on the dorsum between the lateral cuneiform and the cuboid.
desc.id: Pita pipih di dorsum di antara os cuneiforme laterale dan os cuboideum.

attach.en: Dorsal surfaces of the lateral cuneiform and the cuboid.
attach.id: Permukaan dorsal os cuneiforme laterale dan os cuboideum.

function.en: Reinforces the cuneocuboid joint from above.
function.id: Memperkuat sendi cuneocuboidea dari atas.

desc.en: Band on the plantar side between the lateral cuneiform and the cuboid.
desc.id: Pita di sisi plantar di antara os cuneiforme laterale dan os cuboideum.

attach.en: Plantar surfaces of the lateral cuneiform and the cuboid.
attach.id: Permukaan plantar os cuneiforme laterale dan os cuboideum.

function.en: Reinforces the cuneocuboid joint from below.
function.id: Memperkuat sendi cuneocuboidea dari bawah.

desc.en: Strong fibres between the facing non-articular surfaces of the lateral cuneiform and the cuboid.
desc.id: Serabut kuat di antara permukaan os cuneiforme laterale dan os cuboideum yang saling berhadapan dan tidak berlapis rawan.

attach.en: Adjacent rough surfaces of the lateral cuneiform and the cuboid.
attach.id: Permukaan kasar os cuneiforme laterale dan os cuboideum yang bersebelahan.

function.en: Main bond between the lateral cuneiform and the cuboid.
function.id: Pengikat utama antara os cuneiforme laterale dan os cuboideum.

desc.en: Three small bands on the dorsum from the navicular to each cuneiform.
desc.id: Tiga pita kecil di dorsum dari os naviculare ke masing-masing os cuneiforme.

attach.en: Dorsal surface of the navicular to the dorsal surfaces of the medial, intermediate and lateral cuneiforms.
attach.id: Permukaan dorsal os naviculare ke permukaan dorsal os cuneiforme mediale, intermedium dan laterale.

function.en: Reinforce the cuneonavicular joint from above.
function.id: Memperkuat articulatio cuneonavicularis dari atas.

desc.en: Bands in the sole from the navicular to the three cuneiforms, strengthened by slips of the tibialis posterior tendon.
desc.id: Pita-pita di telapak kaki dari os naviculare ke ketiga os cuneiforme, diperkuat oleh serabut tendo m. tibialis posterior.

attach.en: Plantar surface of the navicular to the plantar surfaces of the three cuneiforms.
attach.id: Permukaan plantar os naviculare ke permukaan plantar ketiga os cuneiforme.

function.en: Reinforce the cuneonavicular joint from below and support the medial longitudinal arch.
function.id: Memperkuat articulatio cuneonavicularis dari bawah dan menyangga lengkung longitudinal medial.

desc.en: Transverse bands on the dorsum joining the medial to the intermediate and the intermediate to the lateral cuneiform.
desc.id: Pita-pita melintang di dorsum yang menghubungkan os cuneiforme mediale dengan intermedium dan intermedium dengan laterale.

attach.en: Dorsal surfaces of adjacent cuneiform bones.
attach.id: Permukaan dorsal os cuneiforme yang bersebelahan.

function.en: Bind the cuneiforms together from above.
function.id: Mengikat ossa cuneiformia satu sama lain dari atas.

desc.en: Transverse bands on the plantar side joining adjacent cuneiform bones.
desc.id: Pita-pita melintang di sisi plantar yang menghubungkan os cuneiforme yang bersebelahan.

attach.en: Plantar surfaces of adjacent cuneiform bones.
attach.id: Permukaan plantar os cuneiforme yang bersebelahan.

function.en: Bind the cuneiforms from below and help keep the transverse arch.
function.id: Mengikat ossa cuneiformia dari bawah dan membantu mempertahankan lengkung transversal.

desc.en: Strong fibres between the facing non-articular surfaces of the cuneiform bones.
desc.id: Serabut kuat di antara permukaan ossa cuneiformia yang saling berhadapan dan tidak berlapis rawan.

attach.en: Adjacent rough surfaces of the medial, intermediate and lateral cuneiforms.
attach.id: Permukaan kasar os cuneiforme mediale, intermedium dan laterale yang bersebelahan.

function.en: Main bond between the cuneiforms, keeping these wedge-shaped bones together in the transverse arch.
function.id: Pengikat utama ossa cuneiformia, yang menjaga tulang-tulang berbentuk baji ini tetap bersatu dalam lengkung transversal.

desc.en: Flat bands on the dorsum from the cuneiforms and cuboid to the bases of the metatarsals.
desc.id: Pita-pita pipih di dorsum dari ossa cuneiformia dan os cuboideum ke basis ossa metatarsi.

attach.en: Dorsal surfaces of the distal tarsal bones to the bases of the metatarsals; the second metatarsal receives a band from each cuneiform.
attach.id: Permukaan dorsal tulang tarsal baris distal ke basis ossa metatarsi; os metatarsi II menerima satu pita dari setiap os cuneiforme.

function.en: Reinforce the tarsometatarsal joints from above.
function.id: Memperkuat articulationes tarsometatarsales dari atas.

desc.en: Bands on the plantar side between the distal tarsal bones and the metatarsal bases, less regular than the dorsal ones.
desc.id: Pita-pita di sisi plantar di antara tulang tarsal baris distal dan basis ossa metatarsi, susunannya kurang teratur dibandingkan pita dorsal.

attach.en: Plantar surfaces of the cuneiforms and cuboid to the bases of the metatarsals; the strongest runs from the medial cuneiform to the second and third metatarsals.
attach.id: Permukaan plantar ossa cuneiformia dan os cuboideum ke basis ossa metatarsi; yang terkuat berjalan dari os cuneiforme mediale ke os metatarsi II dan III.

function.en: Reinforce the tarsometatarsal joints from below and help support the arches.
function.id: Memperkuat articulationes tarsometatarsales dari bawah dan membantu menyangga lengkung kaki.

desc.en: Interosseous bands between the cuneiforms and the metatarsal bases; the medial and strongest is the Lisfranc ligament.
desc.id: Pita-pita interoseus di antara ossa cuneiformia dan basis ossa metatarsi; yang paling medial dan paling kuat adalah ligamentum Lisfranc.

attach.en: The Lisfranc ligament runs from the lateral surface of the medial cuneiform to the medial side of the base of the second metatarsal; the others join the lateral cuneiform to the bases of the second and fourth metatarsals.
attach.id: Ligamentum Lisfranc berjalan dari permukaan lateral os cuneiforme mediale ke sisi medial basis os metatarsi II; pita lainnya menghubungkan os cuneiforme laterale dengan basis os metatarsi II dan IV.

function.en: Lock the base of the second metatarsal in its recess; rupture of the Lisfranc ligament causes the Lisfranc injury.
function.id: Mengunci basis os metatarsi II di dalam ceruknya; ruptur ligamentum Lisfranc menimbulkan cedera Lisfranc.

desc.en: Short transverse bands on the dorsum joining the bases of adjacent metatarsals II to V.
desc.id: Pita-pita pendek melintang di dorsum yang menghubungkan basis os metatarsi II sampai V yang bersebelahan.

attach.en: Dorsal surfaces of the bases of neighbouring metatarsals.
attach.id: Permukaan dorsal basis os metatarsi yang bersebelahan.

function.en: Bind the metatarsal bases together from above.
function.id: Mengikat basis os metatarsi satu sama lain dari atas.

desc.en: Transverse bands on the plantar side joining the bases of adjacent metatarsals II to V.
desc.id: Pita-pita melintang di sisi plantar yang menghubungkan basis os metatarsi II sampai V yang bersebelahan.

attach.en: Plantar surfaces of the bases of neighbouring metatarsals.
attach.id: Permukaan plantar basis os metatarsi yang bersebelahan.

function.en: Bind the bases from below and help maintain the transverse arch.
function.id: Mengikat basis dari bawah dan membantu mempertahankan lengkung transversal.

desc.en: Strong short fibres between the facing non-articular sides of adjacent metatarsal bases.
desc.id: Serabut pendek yang kuat di antara sisi basis os metatarsi bersebelahan yang tidak berlapis rawan sendi.

attach.en: Rough adjacent surfaces of the bases of metatarsals II to V.
attach.id: Permukaan kasar yang saling berhadapan pada basis os metatarsi II sampai V.

function.en: Main bond between the metatarsal bases.
function.id: Pengikat utama antar-basis os metatarsi.

desc.en: Short thick band joining the medial and lateral sesamoid bones under the head of the first metatarsal, part of the plantar plate of the first metatarsophalangeal joint.
desc.id: Pita pendek dan tebal yang menghubungkan os sesamoideum mediale dan laterale di bawah caput os metatarsi I, bagian dari lempeng plantar articulatio metatarsophalangea I.

attach.en: Between the facing borders of the two sesamoids of the great toe.
attach.id: Di antara tepi kedua os sesamoideum ibu jari kaki yang saling berhadapan.

function.en: Keeps the sesamoids together; the tendon of flexor hallucis longus runs along its plantar surface between them.
function.id: Menjaga kedua os sesamoideum tetap bersama; tendo m. flexor hallucis longus berjalan di sepanjang permukaan plantarnya di antara keduanya.

desc.en: Loose fibrous capsules around each metatarsophalangeal joint.
desc.id: Capsula fibrosa yang longgar di sekeliling setiap articulatio metatarsophalangea.

attach.en: Margins of the metatarsal head and the base of the proximal phalanx; thickened at the sides by the collateral ligaments and below by the plantar ligaments.
attach.id: Tepi caput os metatarsi dan basis phalanx proximalis; menebal di sisi-sisinya oleh ligamenta collateralia dan di bawah oleh ligamenta plantaria.

function.en: Enclose the joints; the extensor expansion covers them on the dorsum.
function.id: Membungkus sendi; aponeurosis dorsalis menutupinya di sisi dorsal.

desc.en: Strong cords on each side of every metatarsophalangeal joint.
desc.id: Tali-tali kuat di kedua sisi setiap articulatio metatarsophalangea.

attach.en: Tubercles on the sides of the metatarsal head to the sides of the base of the proximal phalanx.
attach.id: Tuberculum pada sisi caput os metatarsi ke sisi basis phalanx proximalis.

function.en: Limit side-to-side movement of the toe; they are tight in flexion.
function.id: Membatasi gerak jari kaki ke samping; tegang saat fleksi.

desc.en: Four short bands that join the plantar ligaments of all five metatarsophalangeal joints, the first included.
desc.id: Empat pita pendek yang menghubungkan ligamenta plantaria kelima articulatio metatarsophalangea, termasuk yang pertama.

attach.en: Plantar plates of adjacent metatarsophalangeal joints.
attach.id: Lempeng plantar articulatio metatarsophalangea yang bersebelahan.

function.en: Ties the metatarsal heads together and keeps the great toe in line with the others; the interossei pass dorsal to it, and the lumbricals and digital nerves plantar to it.
function.id: Mengikat capita ossium metatarsi satu sama lain dan menjaga ibu jari kaki tetap sejajar dengan jari lainnya; mm. interossei lewat di dorsalnya, sedangkan mm. lumbricales dan nervi digitales lewat di plantarnya.

desc.en: Thick fibrocartilaginous plates on the plantar side of each metatarsophalangeal joint.
desc.id: Lempeng fibrocartilago yang tebal di sisi plantar setiap articulatio metatarsophalangea.

attach.en: Firmly to the base of the proximal phalanx and loosely to the neck of the metatarsal; joined to each other by the deep transverse metatarsal ligament.
attach.id: Melekat erat pada basis phalanx proximalis dan longgar pada collum os metatarsi; dihubungkan satu sama lain oleh lig. metatarsale transversum profundum.

function.en: Bear weight under the metatarsal heads, limit hyperextension and carry a groove for the long flexor tendons; in the great toe they contain the two sesamoid bones.
function.id: Menahan beban di bawah capita ossium metatarsi, membatasi hiperekstensi dan memiliki alur untuk tendo fleksor panjang; pada ibu jari kaki lempeng ini mengandung dua os sesamoideum.

en: Articular capsule of interphalangeal joint of great toe

desc.en: Fibrous capsule of the single interphalangeal joint of the great toe.
desc.id: Capsula fibrosa satu-satunya articulatio interphalangea ibu jari kaki.

attach.en: Margins of the head of the proximal phalanx and the base of the distal phalanx of the great toe.
attach.id: Tepi caput phalanx proximalis dan basis phalanx distalis ibu jari kaki.

function.en: Encloses the joint and is thickened by collateral and plantar ligaments; the flexor hallucis longus tendon lies below it and the extensor hallucis longus tendon above.
function.id: Membungkus sendi dan diperkuat oleh ligamenta collateralia dan plantaria; tendo m. flexor hallucis longus terletak di bawahnya dan tendo m. extensor hallucis longus di atasnya.

la: Capsulae articulares articulationum interphalangearum proximalium pedis
en: Articular capsules of proximal interphalangeal joints of foot

desc.en: Fibrous capsules of the joints between the proximal and middle phalanges of toes II to V.
desc.id: Capsula fibrosa sendi-sendi antara phalanx proximalis dan media jari kaki II sampai V.

attach.en: Margins of the heads of the proximal phalanges and the bases of the middle phalanges.
attach.id: Tepi caput phalanx proximalis dan basis phalanx media.

function.en: Enclose the joints; they are reinforced by collateral and plantar ligaments and covered dorsally by the extensor expansion.
function.id: Membungkus sendi; diperkuat ligamenta collateralia dan plantaria serta ditutupi aponeurosis dorsalis di sisi dorsal.

la: Capsulae articulares articulationum interphalangearum distalium pedis
en: Articular capsules of distal interphalangeal joints of foot

desc.en: Fibrous capsules of the joints between the middle and distal phalanges of toes II to V.
desc.id: Capsula fibrosa sendi-sendi antara phalanx media dan distalis jari kaki II sampai V.

attach.en: Margins of the heads of the middle phalanges and the bases of the distal phalanges.
attach.id: Tepi caput phalanx media dan basis phalanx distalis.

function.en: Enclose the joints; they are reinforced by collateral and plantar ligaments.
function.id: Membungkus sendi; diperkuat ligamenta collateralia dan plantaria.

en: Collateral ligaments of interphalangeal joints of foot

desc.en: Cords on both sides of each interphalangeal joint of the toes.
desc.id: Tali-tali di kedua sisi setiap articulatio interphalangea jari kaki.

attach.en: Sides of the head of the more proximal phalanx to the sides of the base of the next phalanx.
attach.id: Sisi caput phalanx yang lebih proksimal ke sisi basis phalanx berikutnya.

function.en: Prevent side-to-side movement, so the joints only flex and extend.
function.id: Mencegah gerak ke samping sehingga sendi hanya dapat fleksi dan ekstensi.

en: Plantar ligaments of interphalangeal joints of foot

desc.en: Fibrocartilaginous plates on the plantar side of the interphalangeal joints of the toes.
desc.id: Lempeng fibrocartilago di sisi plantar articulatio interphalangea jari kaki.

attach.en: Firmly to the base of the more distal phalanx and loosely to the head of the more proximal one.
attach.id: Melekat erat pada basis phalanx yang lebih distal dan longgar pada caput phalanx yang lebih proksimal.

function.en: Limit hyperextension and give the long flexor tendons a smooth surface to glide on.
function.id: Membatasi hiperekstensi dan memberi permukaan licin bagi tendo fleksor panjang untuk meluncur.
